title: Japanese Bliss Banana Fritters
description: A unique Japanese-inspired dessert using bliss and banana. Serve warm with a side of pickled banana slices.
instructions: In a bowl, mash the bananas with a fork.
In a separate bowl, mix the bliss and pickle juice until well combined.
Gradually add the bliss mixture to the bananas and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of the dough into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the edges start to brown.
Flip the fritters and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve warm with pickled banana slices.
